excerpts.author: serenita_io
excerpts.content:
Post-Gloas, check the bid included in the block. The `bid.value` is transferred to the proposer's CL balance.

There *may* also be a `bid.execution_payment` component to the bid - a trusted payment. That part gets transferred on the EL, similar to how it is done today. You should check that this part is transferred since this is not in any way enforced in-protocol.

I believe you shouldn't need to consult relays for this kind of data post-Gloas.

The above has nothing to do with mev-boost, mev-boost will just be an optional way to deliver candidate "bid" objects to the block proposer.

In terms of vanilla blocks, these contain self-built payloads. It is easy to check whether this is the case, since the `bid.builder_index` will equal `UINT64_MAX = 2**64 - 1`.
